analysis.title: HawkEye 360 Inc. (HAWK): 3Q26 First Take: Beat & raise, full year guidance above consensus
key_insights: HAWK 3Q26 revenue of $59.3mn is up 84% y/y and about 5% above FactSet consensus of $56.5mn (GS estimate $56.9mn). International revenue was $23.3mn, up 76% y/y.
Adjusted EBITDA of $13.3mn compares with FactSet consensus of $7.4mn and a GS estimate of $7.7mn. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 22.4% vs 13.5% GS estimate and 29.7% in 3Q25 (down 730bp y/y).

Net loss was $(0.2)mn, vs net income of $1.7mn in 3Q25 per Exhibit 1 (the text says the loss widened from $1.7mn). GS had estimated net income of $4.5mn. Diluted EPS was ($0.00) vs a GS estimate of $0.05.
Operating cash flow was $9.6mn vs FactSet consensus of $6.1mn. Free cash flow was $0.137mn vs FactSet consensus of $(4.0)mn. Backlog ended the quarter at $300.3mn.
The company raised 2026 guidance: revenue $225mn-$227mn (prior $215mn-$220mn, consensus $217mn) and adjusted EBITDA $38mn-$40mn (prior $30mn-$36mn, consensus $33.3mn).
HAWK launched Clusters 15 and 16 in October and established communication with all 6 satellites. The constellation is now 40 satellites on orbit.

GS rates HAWK Buy with a 12-month price target of $32, based on 9.5x 2027E EV/Sales. The stock was $15.26 as of the 11 Nov close, implying 109.7% upside. Market cap is $945.0mn and enterprise value is $443.9mn.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat on revenue and adjusted EBITDA and a raised 2026 guide above consensus. Target is 9.5x 2027E EV/Sales.
